info.title: FeraCal API
info.summary: Complete contract for calendars, events, people, resources, sharing, availability, invitations, and lifecycle
info.description: Source-traced FeraCal contract covering all 34 canonical operations and 34 aliases, tenant/product access, visibility masks, ownership/member roles, sharing, attendee/resource invitations, date-range availability, recurrence/history, and lifecycle HMAC.

tags.name: calendars
tags.description: Create, share, resolve, list, and remove tenant calendars with membership and visibility semantics.

tags.name: people
tags.description: Maintain owner-scoped calendar people and query their time-window availability.

tags.name: resources
tags.description: Maintain owner-scoped reservable resources and query their time-window availability.

tags.name: events
tags.description: Create, invite, query, inspect history, and remove events with recurrence and actor-role semantics.

tags.name: Lifecycle
tags.description: Receive signed FeraLicense product lifecycle commands and acknowledge their completion or safe failure.

parameters.description: Unix timestamp in seconds covered by the exact-body signature.

parameters.name: x-feradel-hook-signature
parameters.description: Versioned SHA-256 HMAC over timestamp, a period, and the exact raw body.
